description: Per-issuer fundamentals for the option-implied credit signal (market-intelligence B3, signal 6 Merton/CreditGrades). Leverage = total_debt vs equity market cap (recovered spot x shares_outstanding); the Merton model then implies a credit spread from that leverage plus the option-implied equity vol. cds_reference_bp is the desk's current single-name CDS level for the cross-check (Merton is an INDICATOR, never a pricing input -- the DTCC CDS feed stays the pricing mark).
provenance: total_debt_usd: EDGAR XBRL LongTermDebtNoncurrent (data/marketdata/reference/edgar_xbrl_facts.csv, FY2026) where available, else the issuer 10-K. shares_outstanding: issuer 10-K cover / latest 10-Q (approximate, slow-moving). cds_reference_bp: the effective single-name CDS spread the pricer uses (ORCL/META from DTCC; AAPL/MSFT/AMZN are the hardcoded fallbacks per the risk data-gap analysis). REFRESH PATH: these are the values ARag facts_lookup would auto-populate (LongTermDebt, shares) -- wiring that refresh is a later enhancement; the config is the reproducible, offline, dual-mode source in the meantime.
